media.title: ARCS Lab Established at UTK
media.description: Dr. Schelble joins the Tickle College of Engineering as a founding faculty member, establishing the AI & Robotics for Collaborative Systems Lab in Fall 2024.

media.title: PNAS Nexus: Toward a Science of Human-AI Teaming
media.description: ARCS Lab contributes to landmark interdisciplinary paper on human-AI teaming for decision-making, co-authored with CMU, Cornell, and other leading institutions. Published February 2026.

media.title: National Academies BOHSI Webinar
media.description: Dr. Schelble presented on performance optimization in human-AI teams at the National Academies' Board on Human-Systems Integration webinar series, September 2025.

media.title: West Point AI Workshop
media.description: Dr. Schelble was invited twice to the United States Military Academy at West Point — as part of the Technical Advisory Panel on AI in Warfare (Feb 2025) and the AI on the Battlefield Workshop (June 2025).

media.title: ARL Award: Compromised AI Teammates
media.description: The ARCS Lab was awarded $718,690 from the Army Research Laboratory to study how human-AI teams can prevent, identify, and mitigate the effects of compromised AI teammates.

media.title: ACM TIIS Featured Article — 2023 & 2024
media.description: "I Know This Looks Bad, But I Can Explain" was selected as a featured article in ACM Transactions on Interactive Intelligent Systems for both 2023 and 2024.
